verdict.rationale: Meltano's CLI is thoroughly documented for headless scaffolding (`meltano init`), configuration (`meltano add`, `meltano config test`), and execution (orchestration via Airflow, containerized runs), all scriptable without a UI. Community reports (GitLab data team) confirm real production use of these CLI-driven pipelines, though no REST/OpenAPI API exists (confirmed 404 probes) so 'API' fallback is unsupported. Missing for 10: explicit documented 'meltano run' end-to-end example, an official API alternative, and independent verification of an agent orchestrating the full flow autonomously.
